Delete this block once the lesson is drafted.

> - Extract the helpers written more than twice: playback, validation, transposition, voicing, articulation.
> - Settle on one event schema and migrate old pieces to it.
> - Keep it small. A framework large enough to hide the score has failed.
> - Write a README that explains the representation choices to you in six months.
>
> **Final checkpoint: you can take a printed score or a short recording and turn it into structured, editable code, and explain the theory encoded in it.**
:::
